answer: In proof-of-stake agent economies, each agent must post a bonded stake and a unique identity commitment, so a sybil cluster cannot harbor many fake identities without locking proportional capital. A randomized beacon operates as a lantern, emitting a verifiable signal that assigns each epoch's proposer duties to a stake-weighted sample, forcing attackers to split capital across. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
